$comment: AUTHORITY for what a registry of knowledge bases keeps in a SessionStorage: the key each thing it keeps is kept under, and the shape of a knowledge base's stored session. A registry in any SDK finds what one in another wrote, over one storage, only if every SDK says these alike. TypeScript (packages/typescript/sdk/src/session/storage.ts and oauth.ts), Rust (packages/rust/sdk/src/session/stored.rs and packages/rust/http-transport/src/oauth.rs) Go (packages/go/sdk/registry/stored.go and packages/go/sdk/authorization.go) and Kotlin (packages/kotlin/sdk/src/main/kotlin/semiont/registry/Stored.kt) state them by hand, and a test in each fails when its copy differs from this table: packages/typescript/sdk/src/session/__tests__/stored-table.test.ts; packages/rust/sdk/tests/tables.rs, with packages/rust/http-transport/tests/sign_in.rs for the key the transport's crate keeps; packages/go/sdk/registry/stored_test.go; packages/kotlin/sdk/src/test/kotlin/semiont/registry/StoredTest.kt. Python: scripts/spec/generate-stored-python.mjs writes packages/python/sdk/src/semiont/stored.py. READING IT. `keys` are the fixed keys, each named as specs/src/client/surface.json names its constant. A knowledge base's session is kept under `sessionKeyPrefix` followed by the knowledge base's id. `storedSession` is what is kept there, as JSON: a flat object schema whose every member is text.

keys.docs: The registered knowledge bases: a JSON list of KnowledgeBase (components/schemas/KnowledgeBase.json).
The id of the active knowledge base. Nothing is kept under it while none is active.
What is open in each knowledge base: a JSON object from a knowledge base's id to the list of its open resources.
Where the person was in each knowledge base: a JSON object from a knowledge base's id to the id of the resource last viewed in it.

A sign-in by a page redirect that is under way: what it remembers across the trip to the issuer and back. It is taken when the sign-in completes, so a callback that is replayed finds nothing to complete.

sessionKeyPrefix.docs: A knowledge base's stored session is kept under this followed by the knowledge base's id.

storedSession.title: StoredSession
storedSession.description: What is kept of a sign-in: the tokens an issuer issued, the client they were issued to, and the issuer's endpoints a renewal and a sign-out need, learned once at sign-in so no session asks again. TOKENS, never a password. A stored value that lacks a member it requires is no session.

access.description: The access token: short-lived, sent as a Bearer token.

refresh.description: The refresh token: what renews the access token at the issuer without another sign-in.

clientId.description: The client the tokens were issued to, which a renewal and a revocation name.

tokenEndpoint.description: The issuer's token endpoint, where the refresh grant is made.

revocationEndpoint.description: The issuer's revocation endpoint (RFC 7009), where a sign-out tells it to forget the refresh token. Absent when the issuer has none.
